justification: The witness is valid: X={0} satisfies the downward-closure definition of a q-complex ([Definition 1](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/371871784_Topological_expansion_for_posets_and_the_homological_k-connectivity_of_random_q-complexes)). Its positive-degree chain modules vanish, so ∂²=0, while (q+1)·1≠0 in ℤ. This genuinely refutes the reverse implication and is distinct from the ground-truth hyperbolic-decomposition flaw.
